summary: Wheeler County tower built in the 1940s for the Oregon Department of Forestry; both lists give it as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register describes the tower as now gone; firelookout.com and the FFLA Oregon list agree; no removal date in these sources

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give only 'the 1940s'; the year shown is the start of that decade
Register lists July 16, 2011 as the registration date, nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: tower built in the 1940s, now gone
evidence.quote: Built in the 1940s, this tower is now gone.

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Dept. of Forestry
Oregon Department of Forestry lists the lookout
register names Ray Kresek as nominator
Forest Fire Lookout Association list: Wheeler County tower, gone
evidence.quote: Sargent Butte Wheeler 44.60897 -120.22751 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1089, OR 446

notes_for_editor: A thin record: no build year beyond the 1940s, no cab or design detail, no staffing, and no removal date in the sources read. One web search turned up no further history. The record's coordinates, elevation (1010.4 m) and agency match the register and firelookout.com; no correction proposed. Nothing describes the site today or its access, so the story says so.
